entry_parity: Every economic entry must byte-match the corresponding frozen Stage-69 count entry ledger before any return is accepted.

lifecycle.ordinary_exit: next matched-MCL minute open after phase boundary, macro-state change, or opposing phase turn
lifecycle.position_limit: one MCL contract direction at a time

discovery_gates.phases: >=20 and stress-positive Asia, Europe, and US
discovery_gates.temporal: >=8 positive months per year and >=75% positive equal-duration quarters

selection: Only complete discovery passers compete by stress PnL/DD, then stress PF, then stress net. Only that selected cell may expose validation outcomes. Validation repeats every gate; full overlap opens only after validation passes.
hard_blockers_after_pass: missing July-2023 through August-2024 canonical dated-contract tape
native liquidity, preview, restart, allocation, and graduation
prohibitions: no new anchor or threshold after outcomes
no stop, target, timeout, or exit rescue
no validation anatomy unless selected by discovery
no news authority, quota, order, or capital authority
